tagline: The Indian Ocean under sail: snow-white beaches, giant granite boulders, palm groves and clear water with coral reefs. By day — islands by yacht and bicycle; in the evening — dinners on board and sunsets.

harbor.note: The trip starts and ends at the Eden Island marina on Mahé. Departure: 20–27 February 2027. Flights are separate; we will help you book a transfer to the marina.

itinerary.title: A week in the Seychelles, day by day

summary.title: A loop around the inner islands of the Seychelles

itinerary.intro: We explore the islands by yacht and bicycle, snorkel over coral reefs and meet giant tortoises.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Meeting on Mahé
days.text: We meet at the marina on the island of Mahé, get to know the captain and crew, settle into our cabins and stock up on everything we need for the week. In the evening, a first dinner, a chance to get better acquainted and a safety briefing.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Praslin
days.text: The first big passage — about four hours across the Indian Ocean: we sunbathe on deck, catch the wind and try trolling for fish. On Praslin — Anse Lazio beach: snow-white sand, huge granite boulders and clear turquoise water.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Curieuse and St Pierre
days.text: In the morning — Curieuse Island, a national park with giant Seychelles tortoises and a trail through the mangroves; after the walk, the beach and the warm ocean. Then tiny St Pierre, where palms grow right among the granite rocks: snorkelling, and in the evening dinner on the yacht under the stars.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Vallée de Mai and Côte d’Or
days.text: After breakfast — the Vallée de Mai national park, a UNESCO World Heritage site and home to the famous coco de mer palm. We walk the shady trails, then have a picnic on Côte d’Or beach and a swim. Towards evening we return to the yacht: dinner, games and one more sunset over the ocean.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: La Digue by bicycle
days.text: We leave the yacht and explore La Digue by bicycle: cosy cafés, vanilla plantations, giant tortoises and Anse Source d’Argent beach with its huge granite boulders and incredible shades of water. We have lunch at a local café and return on board towards evening.

days.label: Day 6
days.title: Félicité and the marine reserve islands
days.text: We say goodbye to La Digue and head out to the small islands of the marine reserve — Félicité, Coco Island or Big Sister. Snorkelling among the coral reefs: bright tropical fish and, with luck, rays and sea turtles. For those who like, a SUP board or fishing straight from the yacht.

days.label: Day 7
days.title: Sainte Anne and the return to Mahé
days.text: Early in the morning we set off for Mahé: breakfast with a view of the islands, the wind and, if you like, the yacht in your hands under the captain’s eye. By lunchtime we anchor off Sainte Anne Island in the national marine park — a last snorkel on the reefs. After lunch we return to the Eden Island marina: the waterfront, shops and a farewell dinner.

days.label: Day 8
days.title: Breakfast and goodbyes
days.text: In the morning we have breakfast on board, recall the brightest moments and swap photos. At 9:00 we check out of the yacht — with salty hair and memories that will keep us warm long after we get home.

itinerary.note: The schedule is flexible: the ocean and the forecast may change the order of the days, but not the route itself.
